message.content:
This is a CBP ruling on an Excalibur remote car starter/alarm set, where the radio remote controls give the set its essential character. Under GRI 3(b) the set classifies as the remote control apparatus, in heading 8526 (radio remote control apparatus), subheading 8526.92 (radio remote control apparatus, other).

The HTSUS 8526.92 subheadings are:
- 8526.92.10 – Radio remote control apparatus: other: Radio remote control apparatus, other than for the remote control of ... (this is the 8526.92.10 line)
- 8526.92.50 – Other

The 8526.92.10 line is "Radio remote control apparatus: Other: Apparatus for the remote control of..." and I believe it is 8526.92.1000 in the older schedule, with 8526.92.5000 as "Other". Since the keyless entry systems for vehicles are not marine or aircraft radio remote control, the better fit is "Other", 8526.92.5000.
